title: A GIS Data Model for Urban Utility Cadastre Compliant with the Serbian Technical Regulation on Underground Installations

record.title: A GIS Data Model for Urban Utility Cadastre Compliant with the Serbian Technical Regulation on Underground Installations
record.abstract: Serbia's technical regulation on underground installations, enacted in 2010, specifies minimum positional accuracy requirements and mandatory attribute sets for utility cadastres but provides no standardised data model. This paper proposes a relational GIS schema implemented in PostgreSQL with the PostGIS extension that maps regulation requirements to feature classes, topology rules and attribute domains. The schema covers six utility categories: water supply, sewerage, gas, district heating, electricity and telecommunications. Topology constraints enforce minimum pipe separation rules and flag intersections lacking documented crossing agreements. The model was populated with survey data for a 1.2 km² pilot area in Subotica municipality and validated against 1:500 municipal plans. Completeness ratio reached 94% for water and 71% for telecommunications, reflecting the poorer documentation state of the latter. The schema is published as an open-source QGIS plugin accompanying this paper.
